name: BlueprintViewer
intent: A single-blueprint viewing workspace at the lowest hierarchy level: a pan/zoom SVG floor-plan canvas with floating overlays — a searchable floor navigator (top-left), a 'Show Multiple' split view (top-center), and zoom tools (top-right) — plus a full-height Building Progress side panel. This is the leaf of the blueprint hierarchy: you have drilled down to one floor and are inspecting its plan, not navigating a portfolio or map of sites.
when: Inspect a single floor's blueprint at the lowest level of the building hierarchy (pan, zoom, walk the plan)
Compare sibling floors side-by-side via a 'Show Multiple' split view under one parent
Show per-floor completion progress beside the plan and jump between floors
A deterministic SVG floor-plan surface (no live map tiles), full-height and full-screenable
whenNot: A geospatial map of project sites / markers -> use the CoreOrgOverview product route or compose Map + MapControls
A master-detail worklist of tasks/alerts/issues -> use the TaskMonitor template
A portfolio or org overview with KPIs + list + map -> use the CoreOrgOverview product route
A small embeddable floor-plan thumbnail -> compose the FloorPlan / canvas pieces directly, not this full workspace

chooseOver.over: Assembling CanvasNavigator + VerticalZoomTools + BuildingProgress + a floor-plan SVG by hand
chooseOver.because: The BlueprintViewer template owns the canvas region layout (navigator / split toggle / zoom tools / progress panel) and the pan/zoom + floor-selection state flow between them.

regions.role: Pan/zoom SVG floor-plan surface (single blueprint or a split multi-floor grid); drag to pan, wheel to zoom
regions.source: FloorPlan (local SVG) + SplitBlueprints (local) inside a pointer-driven pan/zoom surface

regions.role: Searchable floor navigator (top-left) — one branch per building, each floor a leaf; selects the active floor
Top-center 'Show Multiple' split toggle + top-right zoom tools and walk-through action
Full-height right side panel: per-floor progress list, approved-vs-planned hero comparison, and a walk-through CTA
regions.note: Closable via its X and reopened via the top-right 'Show details' button.

regions.role: Header toolbar: breadcrumbs (building > floor) on the left, week selector + full-screen toggle on the right

requiredWidgets.name: CanvasNavigator
requiredWidgets.note: Searchable floor tree overlaid top-left; selecting a floor sets the active blueprint.

requiredWidgets.name: VerticalZoomTools
requiredWidgets.note: Zoom in/out over the floor-plan canvas.

requiredWidgets.name: BuildingProgress
requiredWidgets.note: Tapered building-elevation list of per-floor completion; drives floor selection.

optionalWidgets.name: WeekSelector
optionalWidgets.note: Selects the schedule week the progress reflects.

requiredComponents.name: Toggle
requiredComponents.note: 'Show Multiple' split-view toggle (top-center and in the panel).

requiredComponents.name: Toolbar
requiredComponents.note: Vertical walk-through toolbar matching the zoom tools' radius.

requiredComponents.name: Button
requiredComponents.note: Full-screen toggle and 'Show details' reopen button.

dataContract.note: No props today — floors, weeks, and the floor plans are local fixtures inside the page (BUILDING_FLOORS, WEEKS, FloorPlan). A production widgetization should lift floors + plans + progress to a data source/prop. See dataSources.

dataSources.note: MOCK fixture today — drives the navigator tree, the split view, and the progress list. Production must supply real floor + progress data.
A deterministic hand-drawn SVG floor plan (no live map). Production must render the real blueprint per floor.

dataFlow: BUILDING_FLOORS -> navigator tree (NAV_NODES) + FLOOR_TABS (split view) + progress list
select a floor (navigator or progress list) -> activeFloor + drop to single view -> canvas + breadcrumb + hero comparison
Show Multiple -> showMultiple -> SplitBlueprints renders one section per floor (hero comparison hidden)
drag on the canvas -> pan; wheel / VerticalZoomTools -> zoom -> the floor-plan transform
close the panel -> top-center Show Multiple + top-right Show details / walk-through take over

states.default: Single active floor's blueprint on the canvas, navigator top-left, zoom tools top-right, progress panel open on the right.
states.show-multiple: SplitBlueprints renders every floor as a grid section; the panel's hero comparison hides (no single active floor).
states.panel-closed: Details panel closed; the top-center 'Show Multiple' toggle, a 'Show details' button, and a walk-through toolbar appear over the canvas.
states.full-screen: The viewer promotes to a fixed full-viewport overlay; exit via the button or Esc.
states.panning: Pointer-drag pans the plan; zoom transitions are suppressed while dragging.

responsive.strategy: Full-height workspace: a flexible pan/zoom canvas beside a fixed 288px (w-72) progress panel that can close; overlays are absolutely positioned over the canvas.
responsive.note: The canvas fills remaining space; the progress panel is a fixed-width closable aside. Full-screen escapes the bordered box to the full viewport.

allowedPlacement: route-level single-floor blueprint page (leaf of the blueprint hierarchy)
forbiddenPlacement: nested in another scroll/zoom container (it owns its own pan/zoom + full-height layout)

commonMistakes.mistake: Using it for a geospatial site map
commonMistakes.symptom: Expecting live map tiles / lat-long markers
commonMistakes.fix: This is a deterministic SVG floor-plan viewer; use the CoreOrgOverview product route or compose Map + MapControls for a Mapbox site map.

commonMistakes.mistake: Shipping with the BUILDING_FLOORS / FloorPlan mock fixtures
commonMistakes.symptom: The viewer shows the sample plan and hard-coded floors in production
commonMistakes.fix: Lift floors, plans, and progress to a data source/prop when widgetizing.

commonMistakes.mistake: Embedding the full viewer as a small panel
commonMistakes.symptom: A full pan/zoom workspace crammed into a card slot
commonMistakes.fix: It is a page-level template — give it a full content region; compose FloorPlan/canvas pieces directly for a thumbnail.

commonMistakes.mistake: Placing it inside another scroll container
commonMistakes.symptom: Wheel-zoom fights page scroll and the panel mis-sizes
commonMistakes.fix: Give it a full content region (CoreContentArea).

evaluationCriteria.check: BlueprintViewer chosen for single-floor blueprint inspection — not a Dashboard (map) or TaskMonitor (worklist).
canvas + navigator + view-controls render; the progress panel shows and closes.
CanvasNavigator, VerticalZoomTools, and BuildingProgress are composed rather than re-implemented.
Selecting a floor updates the canvas + breadcrumb; 'Show Multiple' splits the canvas; pan/zoom work.
Produces the full-height blueprint viewer markup with all required regions.

lineage.promotedFrom: web demo page (apps/web BlueprintViewer2Page) — authored template
lineage.archetypeNote: The 'Single Floor' variation of the Building Viewer template's Blueprint Viewer variant, authored from the Blueprint Viewer #2 web demo. Single-floor viewing with a Show-Multiple split toggle; sibling variation is 'Multi-Floor Split' (core-blueprint-viewer-3). Distinct from the map-first Dashboard and the master-detail Monitor.
